title: Feedback
description: A rating somebody gave a thing the software produced, with a line about it if they wrote one. About an output and not about a person: it carries no subject, no consent and no signature, which is what separates it from a testimony.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

targetType.description: What kind of thing was rated. Free text with the two the system records so far: a target type is added whenever something new becomes ratable, and a closed list here would have to be versioned for each one.

target.description: The id of that thing, in the system that owns it. It is read together with targetType and alone means nothing — two kinds of target do not share an id space.

rating.description: The rating as given, 1 to 5. Collected both ways: as a thumb, where only 1 and 5 are ever written, and as the whole scale. Which of the two it was is not recorded, so a mean over mixed records is a number about nothing.

comment.description: What they wrote alongside the rating, in their own words.

session.description: The id of the working session it came from, in the system that holds it. Not a person.
